name: Rail passenger and freight operations
economic_model: Farebox/open access; public-service management fees; contracted freight haulage
boundary: Rail paths, rolling stock, crew, terminals, passenger distribution; avoid double-counting access charges
open_demand: Freight operator dossiers and NI operator accounts still required

name: Rail infrastructure and asset management
economic_model: Public grants, access receipts, renewals and enhancement funding
boundary: Infrastructure and possession planning distinct from train operations/rolling-stock lessors
open_demand: ROSCOs, HS1/HS2, current asset-condition and freight access contracts

name: Road freight, logistics and parcels
economic_model: Contract logistics, shipment/parcel yields and utilisation; regulated letters differ
boundary: Exclude shipper turnover and warehoused product value; GB/NI HGV surveys differ
open_demand: UK legal operator financials, subcontractor economics and current postal remedies

name: Public transport and urban mobility
economic_model: Fares, local grants, concessions, franchising and authority payments
boundary: TfL London, devolved/public bodies, commercial bus and private mobility distinct
open_demand: Wales, local franchising, active travel, taxi/shared-mobility operator economics

name: Roads and highways infrastructure
economic_model: Public settlements, capital and maintenance; no general user farebox
boundary: National Highways England is not UK-wide or all local roads
open_demand: Devolved roads, local authorities, PFI and project-specific procurements

name: Aviation and airports
economic_model: Airline seat/ancillary/holiday economics versus airport charges/retail/property
boundary: Reuse AV-IND-001 / AV-ENT-001; airline Group ≠ UK airport market
open_demand: Other airports, cargo airlines, air navigation and current CAA comparisons

name: Maritime, ports and shipping
economic_model: Handling, storage, property and shipping freight rates are distinct businesses
boundary: Major-port tonnes ≠ TEU ≠ shipping-company revenue; inland legs not additive demand
open_demand: Shipping lines, ferries, harbour trust/municipal models, named rail haulage contracts

name: Transport technology and digital infrastructure
economic_model: Transport use of signalling, control, ticketing, connectivity and operational data
boundary: Cross-sector lens, not a ninth additive market or duplicate Technology Twin
open_demand: Cyber/resilience, OT integration, systems ownership, terms and actual benefits
